lifecycle: source-once-per-request; runtime initialized once per run; no prepared-cache

contract.arrival: constant-rate planned CLOCK_MONOTONIC arrival, independent driver physical core
contract.overload_stop: queue >=48 at 3 consecutive 1Hz samples, after warmup+3sec; stop future arrivals, drain outstanding
contract.latency: response observed by driver minus PLANNED arrival; completed measurement-arrival cohort including completions during drain
contract.queue: worker execution start minus PLANNED arrival, includes external FIFO + IPC/runtime dispatch
contract.throughput: actual response completions inside [warmup,end-of-arrivals), divided by that actual window; drain completions excluded
contract.cpu: all offered admitted requests + drain, per completed request; runtime initialization excluded; includes service Host/native parent/reaped children, driver separate
contract.statistics: mean/min/max of independent-run nearest-rank percentiles; never pooled percentiles
contract.sustained_v2: full >=8sec window; no rejects/errors/timeouts; all arrival-cohort complete; completion rate >=98% offered; backlog slope <=max(0.5,1% offered) req/s; last-third p99 <=1.5*first-third p99+2ms; mean last 3 WAITING queue samples <=max(2,5% offered). Engineering screen, not an SLA or indefinite stability proof.
contract.loss_display: plot completed latency together with rejected/timeout/failed fractions and early-stop flags; censored/missing latency never 0; finite p99 conditional on completions
